lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of circular high-luminance spots is visible posterior to the gill slits. The pattern consists of approximately four horizontal rows of spots, with the second and third rows from the top exhibiting the highest pixel intensity and most regular spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the high-luminance spots, particularly visible in the mid-flank region where the bands create anchor nodes at the center of the blobs.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank. The most prominent ridge begins superior to the fifth gill slit and extends posteriorly, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow gradient across its vertical axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette, partially visible in the upper right quadrant, displays a cluster of at least five high-luminance spots distributed unevenly across its visible surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, high-contrast objects (commensal fish) clustered around the ventral-anterior region and trailing the pectoral fin.
